name: Goflex
description: Gofilex has over 35 years experience in providing distribution services to the Dutch film Industry.  We have the largest specialized warehouse facilities in the North of Europe: The Netherlands. We not only store, manage and control more then 20.000 prints,We work in close collaboration with the branch organisations NVF (Distributors) and NVB (Exhibitors). For various film services we have formed a collective non- profit organisation which represents the interests of all members and monitors the logistics of content and the corresponding trends in the Dutch film industry. but also HD’s, trailers and all corresponding POS materials. We have developed a closed private logistics network and weekly we handle over 4.500 shipments.  Since 2008 we provide digital logistic solutions that deliver film content from sources to Cinema’s via secured managed file transfer. Our Gofilex ODD™ (Organized Digital Distribution) technology is facilitating the digital delivery to multiple Cinema’s across the Netherlands and Europe. We have integrated the digital and physical logistics into one workflow.  With combined distribution solutions tailored to your needs, Gofilex ODD™ is the secure, efficient and reliable solution to all your distribution needs.
